build.definition: We build what the approved scope says, in a test environment.
build.exit: Moves to Eclipse review once the whole scope is built.

eclipseReview.name: Eclipse review
eclipseReview.definition: We test everything before showing you: phones, speed, copy, forms and links.
eclipseReview.exit: Moves to your review once it clears our checklist with nothing open.

clientReview.name: Client review
clientReview.definition: Your turn: you review and approve, or ask for tweaks within scope.
clientReview.exit: Moves to Delivery once your approval is recorded.

delivery.name: Delivery
delivery.definition: We launch, hand over access and documentation, and train your team.
delivery.exit: Done once it's live and the training has happened.

support.name: Support
support.definition: While maintenance is active we look after hosting, backups and the changes your plan includes.
support.exit: Lasts as long as maintenance is contracted.

paused.name: Paused
paused.short: With a reason and next action
paused.definition: Work is on hold for a specific reason. We always tell you which one and what it takes to resume.
paused.exit: Resumes once the reason is resolved.

closed.name: Closed
closed.short: With a reason and next action
closed.definition: The project ended or was cancelled. The reason is recorded, plus what comes next, if anything.

detail.noAction: Nothing pending on your side right now.
